turns.text: Thanks for calling Copper Wok Eastside, how can I help?
Hi, can I get a delivery? I'd like the sesame green beans and the scallion pancakes and the pad see ew.
Also, my daughter has a tree nut allergy.
Of course. So we're checking for tree nut, for your daughter, right?
Our allergen list doesn't show tree nut in what you ordered. We do cook everything in one kitchen, so there is some risk of cross-contact.
Happy to. What address should we deliver to?
You're inside our delivery zone. That's sesame green beans and scallion pancakes and pad see ew, $52.50 with the delivery fee. The driver should be there in about 45 minutes.
Can I get a name and phone number for the order?
